title: AI Isn't Replacing Developers: It's Creating Jobs! #shorts
description: Major players like Anthropic, Microsoft, and OpenAI are investing billions in a surprising trend: manually embedding AI engineers into businesses. This doesn't signal AI replacing jobs, but creating the largest developer job market in years. #AIJobs #FutureOfWork #TechIndustry #Developer

top_comments.author: @veselinlazovic3997
top_comments.text:
There is complex relationship between knowledge, skill, competence, mastery and expertise in humans. It takes time to develop expertise and going thru all levels of knowledge and skill is not optional. AI can support human expert by providing many options, but it’s human expert that determines what opportunities are valuable.
I just worry that availability of knowledge (facts actually) and perceived skills will trick us to stop investing in juniors becoming seniors

top_reply.author: @STARTUPHAKK_sh
top_reply.text: That’s a really good point — facts are easy to grab now, but judgment and taste still come from time on the ground. If we skip the grind of learning through mistakes and mentoring, we end up with people who can prompt but can’t steer. Do you think teams today are still making space for that slow climb from junior to senior?
